playlist_id = 654

# Parse each song line into title and artists
songs_to_add = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Split on " by " to get title and artist part
    parts = line.split(' by ')
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artists_part = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ''
    # Split artists by comma
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
    songs_to_add.append((title, artists))

print(songs_to_add)
